_description: Credential dumps, database leaks, and session/cookie marketplaces. All rules require multiple co-occurring signals to suppress security-research posts about HaveIBeenPwned, news stories about historical breaches, and analyst writeups.

rules._description: Combolist / credential-pair dump for sale or free distribution. Two-signal lookahead: combolist/pair-format language + quality/sale/distribution context. Real combolist drops include scale ('1M lines'), quality marker ('UHQ', 'HQ', 'fresh', 'private'), or direct sale/share intent.
rules._fp_risk: Low. 'email:pass' format and 'combolist' jargon rarely appear in benign contexts.
rules._severity_rationale: High - combolist drops enable credential-stuffing at scale.
rules.name: Credentials - combolist drop / sale

rules._description: Database leak / breach drop. Two-signal lookahead: database/breach-leak language + scale or sale/share intent. Distinguishes underground dump posts from breach-disclosure news.
rules._fp_risk: Low-medium. News coverage of breaches uses similar language - excludes pin obvious news outlets and corporate-disclosure language.
rules._severity_rationale: High - database leaks expose user data and downstream credential-reuse risk.
rules.name: Credentials - database leak / breach drop

rules._description: Session token / cookie marketplace - sale or trade of valid browser cookies, JWTs, or OAuth sessions for high-value SaaS (Genesis Market style). Two-signal lookahead: cookie/session/token term + sale/marketplace/quality language.
rules._fp_risk: Low. 'Cookies marketplace' and 'valid sessions for sale' is not benign phrasing.
rules._severity_rationale: High - valid session cookies bypass MFA and offer immediate account takeover.
rules.name: Credentials - session / cookie marketplace

rules._description: Free / public credential dumps in dedicated channels - drops without explicit sale intent. Two-signal lookahead: dump/drop language + free/public/fresh marker + scale.
rules._fp_risk: Low-medium. Some posts may be takedown notices or HIBP imports - excludes catch typical research framing.
rules._severity_rationale: High - free dumps reach broader attacker population, faster downstream abuse.
rules.name: Credentials - free public dump
